scope: Independent AI semantic cross-review of all20 ja/ko full articles and20 SEO against recovered frozen English masters. Reviewer did not author these ja/ko pages.
method: Read all body paragraphs, tables, FAQ, source sections and public SEO fields in both target languages; compared substantive meaning to frozen English masters. Structural/numeric checks below are secondary corroboration, not semantic-review substitutes.
limitations: Translation review against frozen English, not a fresh independent fact-source or legal review.
No guarantee of flawless native editorial style; no human or professional certification.
Site indexing, image rendering and live publication not tested here.
